networkMode.description: The gateway mode actually in force, echoed so it can be verified rather than assumed. `stub` reaches no external network and needs no credentials.

received.description: Units of demand successfully processed since start.

failed.description: Units that failed and will be re-fetched. A failure deliberately does not advance the watermark, so nothing is skipped; processing is idempotent on `networkRef`, which is what makes the retry safe.

since.description: The watermark the next poll will use. ABSENT before any pass has completed cleanly — which after real uptime is itself the signal that no poll has ever succeeded.

overdue.description: Of those, how many have already missed their acknowledgement window. Above zero is worth alerting on.

500.description: An RFC 7807 problem document. A NUL character (U+0000) is never valid input (PostgreSQL text cannot hold it): in the request path it is a 404 `resource-not-found`, in a query parameter a 400 `invalid-request`, and in a request body a 400 `malformed-request-body`.
